newsitem.title: UK: LPC - Russia's Mezhkombank in $20 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC - Russia's Mezhkombank in $20 mln loan.

text.p: LONDON, February 18 (LPC) - Russia's Mezhkombank has mandated London Forfaiting Asia to arrange a new $20 million credit, according to a banker close to the deal.
The 180-day credit is priced at 525 bps over LIBOR and is due to launch into general syndication later this week.
Bayersiche Vereinsbank, Komercni Banka and Raiffelson Zentral Bank joined the deal as joint-arrangers prior to general syndication. The credit is fully underwritten by the arranging team.
In December 1996, Mezhkombank signed a five-year $20 million revolving credit which was arranged by EBRD.
